title: 2023年3月四级真题 第1套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage:
P1 It's good to be smart. After all, intelligent people earn more money, accumulate more wealth, and even live longer. But there's another side to the story. The brightest people and strongest leaders sometimes make errors others don't, especially in situations that require common sense.

P2 Travis Bradberry, president at TalentSmart, explained in his post Why Smart People Act So Stupid that "Rational thinking and intelligence don't tend to go hand in hand. Intelligent people are more prone to silly mistakes because of blind spots in how they use logic. These blind spots exist because smart people tend to be overconfident in their reasoning abilities." They are so used to being right and having quick answers that they don't even realise when they're making a mess by answering without thinking things through.

P3 A lifetime of praise leads smart people to develop too much faith in their intelligence and abilities. They often fail to recognise when they need help, and when they do recognise it, they tend to believe that no one else is capable of providing it.

P4 "It's hard for anyone to graciously accept the fact that they're wrong. It's even harder for smart people because they grow so used to being right all the time that it becomes a part of their identity," Bradberry wrote. "For smart people, being wrong can feel like a personal attack, and being right, a necessity."

P5 Smart people also have a hard time accepting feedback. They tend to undervalue the opinions of others, which means they have trouble believing that anyone is qualified to give them useful feedback. Not only does this tendency hinder their growth and performance, it can lead to harmful relationships, both personally and professionally.

P6 Smart people develop overachieving personalities because things come so easily to them. They simply don't understand how hard some people have to work to accomplish the same things, and because of that, they push people too hard. They set the bar too high, and when people take too long or don't get things quite right, they assume it's due to a lack of effort. So they push even harder.

questions.q: What do we learn from the passage about the brightest people?
options: They can make silly mistakes in straightforward situations.
They usually turn a blind eye to their own weaknesses.
They are admired by people around them.
They can differ in their personalities.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What do we learn from the passage about the brightest people? 是开放式问 "关 于聪明人我们知道了什么"，没有 infer/imply 之类的推断信号，也不问主旨或态度——属 于覆盖全篇的细节判断题。 46. What do we learn from the passage about the brightest people? A) They can make silly mistakes in straightforward situations. B) They usually turn a blind eye to their own weaknesses. C) They are admired by people around them. D) They can differ in their personalities.

【拆句】What do we learn from the passage about the brightest people? 主干是 what do we learn，about the brightest people 是后置介词短语修饰 learn 的内容范围；结构平铺直 叙，无陷阱。

【定位】The brightest people and strongest leaders sometimes make errors others don't, especially in situations that require common sense. 最聪明的人和最强的领导者有时会犯别人不会犯的错，尤其是在那些需要常识的场合。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 make errors others don't, especially in situations that require common sense ↔ make silly mistakes in straightforward situations They can make silly mistakes in straightforward situations. 把预判的 "在常识场景中 犯错" 完整复现，且与定位句逐成分对应，是定位句的同义替换。 B) 无中生有 文章只说聪明人有 blind spots in how they use logic，并没有说他们对 "自己的弱点 视而不见"——turn a blind eye to their own weaknesses 是凭文字面感受瞎想出来的 关联。 C) 无中生有 文章只提到 intelligent people earn more money, accumulate more wealth, and even live longer，没说他们被人 "敬仰"——admired by people around them 属原文 未提的事实陈述。 D) 答非所问 末段确实提到 Smart people develop overachieving personalities，但全文聚焦的是 聪明人的共性问题，并未论述他们 "个性各异"——differ in their personalities 与文章 问的 "我们了解到什么" 不在一个频道。 聪明人的逻辑盲点存在的原因是什么? A) 他们不理性的思维方式。 B) 对自己思考能力过度自信。 C) 他们对行为科学的无知。 D) 对工作过度关注。

questions.q: What accounts for the existence of intelligent people's logical blind spots?
options: Their irrational way of thinking.
Too much faith in their ability to think.
Their ignorance of behavioural science.
Too much concern about their work
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What accounts for the existence of intelligent people's logical blind spots? 指向 一个具体概念（逻辑盲点）的成因，是回到具体段落找因果句的细节题。 47. What accounts for the existence of intelligent people's logical blind spots? A) Their irrational way of thinking. B) Too much faith in their ability to think. C) Their ignorance of behavioural science. D) Too much concern about their work

【拆句】What accounts for the existence of intelligent people's logical blind spots? 主干 what accounts for X，X 是 the existence of intelligent people's logical blind spots （名词化结构，相当于问 "为什么聪明人会存在逻辑盲点"），把名词化拆回动词理解即可。

【定位】Intelligent people are more prone to silly mistakes because of blind spots in how they use logic. These blind spots exist because smart people tend to be overconfident in their reasoning abilities. 聪明人更容易犯傻错，是因为他们运用逻辑时存在盲点。这些盲点之所以存在，是因为聪明 人倾向于对自己的推理能力过度自信。

【选项】A) 与原文相反 原文说聪明人 Rational thinking and intelligence don't tend to go hand in hand ——意思是聪明人未必理性，但这并不等于他们 "思维不理性" 就是盲点的成因；真正的 成因是过度自信。irrational way of thinking 把伴生现象当成因，属于因果倒置。 B) ✓ 正确 overconfident in their reasoning abilities ↔Too much faith in their ability to think Too much faith in their ability to think. 把原文 "对推理能力过度自信" 的核心搬过 来，且 faith / ability to think 两个成分都能在定位句里逐一着落。 C) 无中生有 ignorance of behavioural science 把 "行为科学" 这种学科概念引进来——但文章自始 至终没有提行为科学，是凭空捏造的成因。 D) 无中生有 文章没有说聪明人 "过度关心工作"——Too much concern about their work 是凭日常 对 "聪明人=工作狂" 的刻板印象瞎编出来的。 聪明人在被发现错误时会如何反应? A) 他们把责任推给别人。 B) 他们大度地接受事实。 C) 他们可能会感到震惊。 D) 他们可能会感到被ଛ冒犯。

questions.q: How do smart people react when they are found to be wrong?
options: They shift the blame to others.
They graciously accept the facts.
They may feel shocked.
They may get offended.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 How do smart people react when they are found to be wrong? 限定了具体情境 "被发现错了"，问对应反应，是定位到具体段落求证的细节题。

【拆句】How do smart people react when they are found to be wrong? 主句 How do smart people react，when 引导时间状语从句限定情境；从句用被动语态 are found to be wrong（被发现错了），主体仍是 smart people。 48. How do smart people react when they are found to be wrong? A) They shift the blame to others. B) They graciously accept the facts. C) They may feel shocked. D) They may get offended.

【定位】For smart people, being wrong can feel like a personal attack, and being right, a necessity. 对聪明人来说，被认定为错可以感觉像一次人身攻击，而正确则是一种必需。

【选项】A) 过度推断 原文没有说聪明人会 "把责任推给别人"——shift the blame to others 是凭 "聪明人不 愿承认错" 这一印象想象出来的下游行为。 B) 与原文相反 原文恰恰说 It's hard for anyone to graciously accept the fact that they're wrong. It's even harder for smart people——聪明人尤其难以坦然接受。graciously accept the facts 直接照搬原文短语却把否定关系反过来，是典型反向陷阱。 C) 偷换概念 feel shocked 把 "被冒犯/受攻击感" 偷换成 "震惊"——shocked 强调对事实意外， offended 强调对自尊受损的反应，两种情绪不同。 D) ✓ 正确 being wrong can feel like a personal attack ↔They may get offended. They may get offended. 把比喻 a personal attack 翻译成 get offended，是情绪反 应的同义动词化，且 may 与原文 can 在语气上一致。 那些难以接受建议的聪明人可能会发生什么? A) 他们可能在职业和私人生活中遭受困扰。 B) 他们可能对自己的管理能力失去信心。 C) 他们可能比以往犯更多错误。 D) 他们可能经历大量情绪压力。

questions.q: What may happen to smart people who find it difficult to accept suggestions?
options: They may suffer in their professional and private life.
They may lose faith in their administrative abilities.
They may commit more errors than ever before.
They may experience a lot of emotional stress.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What may happen to smart people who find it difficult to accept suggestions? 问 "对接受不了建议的聪明人会发生什么"，是对特定情境后果的细节求证。

【拆句】What may happen to smart people who find it difficult to accept suggestions? 主干 是 what may happen to smart people；who find it difficult to accept suggestions 是 修饰 smart people 的定语从句，限定了 "哪一类聪明人"。

【定位】Not only does this tendency hinder their growth and performance, it can lead to harmful relationships, both personally and professionally. 这种倾向不仅会阻碍他们的成长与表现，还可能导致有害的人际关系——无论是私人层面还 是职业层面。 49. What may happen to smart people who find it difficult to accept suggestions? A) They may suffer in their professional and private life. B) They may lose faith in their administrative abilities. C) They may commit more errors than ever before. D) They may experience a lot of emotional stress.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 harmful relationships, both personally and professionally ↔ suffer in their professional and private life suffer in their professional and private life 既覆盖了原文 "professionally" 又覆盖了 "personally"——两个并列限定都能落地，是定位句的完整同义改写。 B) 偷换概念 原文说 hinder their growth and performance，是 "阻碍成长与表现"，并未说他们 "对自己的管理能力失去信心"——lose faith in their administrative abilities 把 "成长 与表现受阻" 偷换成 "对管理能力失去信心"。 C) 无中生有 原文没有把 "接受不了反馈" 与 "犯更多错" 直接挂钩——commit more errors than ever before 是把第一段的 errors 概念硬拉到第五段后果中。 D) 无中生有 experience a lot of emotional stress 把后果限定为 "情绪压力"——但原文说的是 "成 长与表现受阻 + 关系有害"，从未提及情绪压力。 关于那些与成就卓越的人共事或在其手下工作的人,文中说了什么? A) 他们在工作中投入大量精力。 B) 他们为自己设定更高的目标。 C) 他们承受着越来越大的压力。 D) 他们完成事情所需的时间更少。

questions.q: What is said about those working with or under overachieving people?
options: They put a lot of effort into their work.
They set higher goals for themselves.
They are under increasing pressure.
They take less time to get things done.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What is said about those working with or under overachieving people? 问 "关于 和聪明人共事的人，文章说了什么"，是末段定位的细节题。

【拆句】What is said about those working with or under overachieving people? 主干 What is said about X；X 是 those working with or under overachieving people，其中 working with or under overachieving people 是分词短语后置修饰 those，表示 "那些与 过分追求成就的人共事或在其手下做事的人"。注意 with or under 是并列介词，对象都是 overachieving people。

【定位】They set the bar too high, and when people take too long or don't get things quite right, they assume it's due to a lack of effort. So they push even harder. 他们把标杆定得太高，当别人花的时间过长或事情做得不够准确时，他们就认定这是因为对 方努力不够，于是施压得更狠。 50. What is said about those working with or under overachieving people? A) They put a lot of effort into their work. B) They set higher goals for themselves. C) They are under increasing pressure. D) They take less time to get things done.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 原文说聪明人 assume it's due to a lack of effort——是聪明人 "以为" 别人不努力， 并不是别人真的努力。put a lot of effort into their work 把聪明人的 "以为" 当成事 实，恰好与原文意涵相反。 B) 张冠李戴 set higher goals for themselves 这一行为在原文里属于聪明人——They set the bar too high，主语是聪明人；选项却把它安在 "和聪明人共事的人" 头上，是把行为主体张 冠李戴。 C) ✓ 正确 they push people too hard ↔They are under increasing pressure. So they push even harder. ↔increasing pressure They are under increasing pressure. 既覆盖 push people 的施压主轴（变成 under pressure），又覆盖 push even harder 的加码动态（变成 increasing），两个成分都 能在原文找到落点。 D) 与原文相反 原文说聪明人 when people take too long——意思是这些人花的时间 "过长"，而 take less time to get things done 把 "过长" 反成 "更短"，方向相反。
